summary_en: Interim dividend raised ¥62→¥136/share (+119%), year-end dividend raised ¥110→¥223/share (+103%), annual total ¥172→¥359/share (+109%). Payout ratio not disclosed. Effective dates per standard dividend schedule (interim: end-Q2 2026; year-end: pending final quarter results).
title_en: Notice on Difference Between Second Quarter FY2026 Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Results, Upward Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast, and Modification (Increase) of Interim and Year-End Dividend Forecasts
translation_en_brief: Yokohama Rubber announced an upward revision of its FY2026 (calendar year ending December 31, 2026) dividend forecast on August 10, 2026. The interim dividend (payable at end of Q2 2026) is raised from ¥62 per share to ¥136 per share, an increase of 119%. The year-end dividend is raised from ¥110 per share to ¥223 per share, an increase of 103%. The revised annual total dividend is ¥359 per share, up from the previously forecast ¥172 per share, representing a 109% increase. The revision follows better-than-forecast H1 results (revenue ¥639.4 billion vs. forecast ¥610 billion; parent-attributable profit ¥72.6 billion vs. forecast ¥45 billion), driven by favorable raw-material costs in off-highway tires, favorable currency effects from yen depreciation, pricing actions, sales growth in Europe and India, higher-margin specialty tires, and structural improvements in the multi-business segment. The company also raised full-year net income guidance by 7.3% (¥109 billion → ¥117 billion) and operating profit by 4.2% (¥191.5 billion → ¥199.5 billion), citing ongoing price-cost management and strong momentum, despite lingering geopolitical headwinds in the Middle East.
